title: Product Variants and Prices: Sizes, Colors, SKUs and Recurring Prices | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A shirt in three sizes and two colors is one product with variants, not six products. CrestApps variants give each combination of a product's options its own SKU, price and picture, shoppers choose a variant before adding to the cart, and the Product prices part offers one item once, monthly, yearly or for an amount the buyer names.

In this video:
• Why variants and prices, and how options, variants and prices fit together
• Giving the Product type its options with the Product variants part
• Entering a product's values, and each variant's SKU and price
• What shoppers see: From prices, filters and one list for each option
• The Product prices part: once, recurring, dates and the buyer's own amount
